caption:
"It's been up and down" is Mr Turtle's answer every time. A pain diary gives a lot more to work with.

Pain often shows up a day after the activity that stirred it, so Tuesday's gardening can turn into Wednesday's ache. Writing it down makes those links easier to spot.

Hybi's one-line diary: a pain score out of 10, what you did, how you slept and what helped. Note the wins too, and look at a week or two rather than one rough day.

Bring it to your next session so our team at Hybrid Physio can adjust your plan. Book online via the link in bio 📝

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
